data.name: Natubhai
data.gender_notes: Natubhai is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Natubhai is a compound name, consisting of two parts - 'Natu' and 'Bhai'. 'Natu' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nathu', which means 'Lord' or 'Master'. 'Bhai' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bhagavan', which means 'God' or 'Lord'. Thus, Natubhai can be translated as 'Lord of the Earth'. The name Natubhai carries the meaning “Lord of the Earth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi. Parents who choose Natubhai usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the earth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Natubhai is a divine name, revered by many Hindus. It is believed to evoke the blessings of Lord Shiva, the deity associated with nature and the destroyer of negative energies. Natubhai is a name that instills a sense of reverence, respect, and awe.
data.etymology: Natubhai belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Earth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Natubhai total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
